name: WATonomous
description: The flagship autonomy design team at Waterloo, building software for autonomous vehicles, robotics platforms, and self-driving racecars.

cycles.notes: General membership is rolling admission across the Autonomous Software, Autonomous Platform, and Business Operations divisions, no deadline. Each division runs its own onboarding. WATcloud onboards separately, either by picking up a listed starter project or filling out the form at cloud.watonomous.ca. The careers page also lists specific exec and lead roles plus an Expedited Admission track, all separate from general recruitment. The expedited page still shows the September 2025 window, so there is no open expedited round right now.
